definitions.explanation: a small raised bump or spot on the skin, typically caused by blocked pores or skin irritation

examples.japanese: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a pimple on my face.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: I got more pimples from stress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{脂|あぶら}っこい→脂っこい：14728_aburakkoi⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: If you keep eating greasy food, you're likely to get pimples.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの} literally means "something that blows/springs out" (⟦{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す→吹き出す：06342_fukidasu⟧ = to spring up, ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ = thing).

VS. ニキビ:
- {吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの} - more general term for skin blemishes, often used by adults
- ⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧ - typically refers to adolescent acne; more casual

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ - to get a pimple
- {吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧ - for a pimple to heal
- {吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{潰|つぶ}す→潰す：00410_tsubusu⟧ - to pop a pimple

CAUSES:
- ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧ - stress
- ⟦{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧ - lack of sleep
- ⟦{偏|かたよ}った→偏る：07872_katayoru⟧⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧ - unbalanced diet
- ⟦ホルモン→ホルモン：29936_horumon⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧ - hormonal imbalance

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧ - pimple (casual)
